supporting_passages: ### Klondike Kluane Loop, Yukon — A **Yukon road trip** is one of the most epic trips in Canada

The Klondike Kluane Loop Yukon road trip route heads north to the gold rush town of Dawson City before driving up the Dempster Highway to one of our favorite parks in the world, Tombstone Territorial Park.
Afterward, it's back down to Dawson and across Alaska via the scenic Top of the World Highway.
The final section involves the imposing Kluane National Park and Reserve, home to monstrous glaciers and Canada's tallest mountain, Mount Logan.
- **Duration:** 8-12 days
- **Highlights:** Dawson City, Chicken, Alaska, Dempster Highway
After crossing into Alaska we drove through the town of small of Chicken and back into the Yukon to enjoy the Kluane National Park and take a Glacier Flight to see Mount Logan.
Huge thanks to Overland Yukon for the Jeep rental
